screens.tabs: The tab bar at the bottom of every main screen
screens.home: Home, for a manager or administrator
screens.pending: Today — unplanned visits waiting to sync
screens.sync: The sync line on Today and Day end, and the sign-out warning
screens.tracking: The live location line on Today and Me
screens.day: Banners about the day and the time zone, on several screens
screens.remedy: What to do when the server refuses something, on many screens
screens.doctors: The Doctors tab (the searchable list of the rep's doctors) and one doctor's profile (the rep's own visit history with them)
screens.route: Today's route (the beat plan): the day's planned stops in order, the next stop, and what happened at each
screens.unplanned: Add an unplanned visit: choose a doctor and clinic, give a reason, and start the visit
screens.map: The map of the rep's clinics, or of today's stops (only in builds with maps)
screens.coaching: Coaching (the tab): the rep's own reviewed visits, AI-written findings and a monthly count. Never a score
screens.analysis: One analysis of a visit: what worked, what to try, each with a quote from the transcript
screens.reply: The rep's reply to an analysis, which the manager sees beside the finding
screens.ai: Shared by the AI screens (assistant, AI Doctor practice): the daily allowance notice, how a reset time is written, and the button that plays a quoted recording in feedback
screens.assistant: The assistant: the rep asks how to do something in this app. The answers themselves come from the server and are not in this file
screens.productQa: Product questions: answered only from the company's approved material, with the source shown. Answers and source titles come from the server and are not in this file
screens.practice: AI Doctor practice: choose a practice scenario, talk to an AI doctor, and read feedback. The doctor's lines and the feedback text come from the server and are not in this file
screens.visit: The visit screen: one visit from arriving to leaving — check in, check out, the recording bar, and the actions during and after the visit
screens.adverse: Flag a possible side effect (adverse event), opened from a visit. The guidance about what the report is and what must not be written stays in English and is not in this file
screens.report: The call report: what the rep writes after a visit (what happened, what the doctor raised, the next step, the products discussed), and what happened when they sent it
screens.samples: Leave samples: the samples and materials the rep left at a visit, how many, and their declared value, with a note about the UCPMP sample limit
screens.voiceNote: The rep's own voice note after a visit: hold a button to record, then save it. Nobody else is in the recording
screens.queue: Saved on this phone: the list of the rep's work waiting to send, what is stuck, and why the server refused something
screens.stepper: The minus / plus count control (for example, how many packs on Leave samples). Read aloud by a screen reader
screens.mileage: Mileage — distance on this month's claim, day by day
screens.dataSettings: Mobile data — the WiFi-only and 100 MB settings
screens.transparency: What this app records — the list of what is and is never recorded
screens.liveTracking: Live location — the screen around the company's notice (the notice itself is not translated here)
screens.onboarding: First run (location, notifications, battery & autostart, microphone) and the start-up error screen
screens.learning: Learning: the courses assigned to the rep, one course's lessons, and a lesson to read and mark finished, with its video. Course, module and lesson titles, market names and a lesson's text come from the server and are not in this file
screens.tutor: The lesson tutor, under a lesson: the rep asks about that lesson and an AI answers only from its text. The answers come from the server and are not in this file
